request.prompt:
EDIT reference image 1 (the helmet strike card). Recompose this SAME scene into the following exact layout, removing the enormous diagonal bear arm completely. Image 2 and 3 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: retain mature graphic flat-color aesthetics and Volibear's navy/white/cyan identity, do not copy their giant arm/shoulder layouts.

Landscape 25:19, unframed illustration, no words or UI. The ENEMY is now the main large shape: a large clearly recognizable iron-grey helmet in center, its connected neck and broad dark armored shoulders fill the lower two thirds. Side-back view, head and neck sink down and slightly right from the impact. Helmet -> short neck -> shoulders must be one continuous enemy body. Use a smooth domed/angular helmet in only 3 broad metal planes, a dark slit or plate seam for recognition, no face detail. The enemy helmet is much wider than the bear's paw.

Only ONE SHORT VERTICAL BEAR WRIST enters directly down from the MIDDLE OF THE TOP EDGE (x 52%). Its visible length above the hand is only about 10% of the canvas height. It leads into one compact loosely closed navy bear paw whose width is only about 20% of the canvas width. Show the BACK OF THE PAW toward the viewer, short wrist bend evident. Its outside lower heel strikes the helmet top. Four short cyan claw tips curl together inward behind the contact, all in one natural direction, not gripping around the helmet and not pointing backwards. Leave broad red negative space to BOTH left and right of this small vertical wrist. No diagonal arm entering from the left, no bear shoulder, chest or head anywhere. The visible entire bear wrist-plus-paw must occupy less than 12% of the image area, never a giant foreground fist. Keep the paw small relative to the helmet: helmet about 43% canvas width, paw about 20% width.

One tiny ivory compressed contact wedge under the paw heel shows the downward blow. The helmet is tipped and the connected neck and shoulder sink down in the same direction; pressure is read from the enemy body, not explosive effects. No blood, wound or fragments.

Background is wine-red, reduced to TWO large flat red shapes with generous clear negative space; remove all fine red shard patterns and repeated jagged rays. All forms use hard, closed graphic edges, minimal dark outline, only 2 or 3 flat value planes per material. White-grey fur is one simple top wrist fringe, no little tuft textures. Clean large metal and armor shapes, no grain, no render gradients, no 3D fur, no particles, no extra hands, no extra limb, no extra claws. Keep card aspect exactly 25:19. The changed size hierarchy and vertical top-center entrance are the highest priority.

revision_reason: Root cross-review: reduce repeated enormous diagonal arm layout; enemy helmet/neck/shoulders dominate; only top-center short wrist and compact paw, simpler red backdrop.

plan_card.prompt:

卡片：C04《擂首一击》。创作一张新的独立插画，核心动词/关系为“擂下”。

镜头与抽象：敌人侧后方近景。M0。
画面：敌方头盔位于画面下中部，一段从上缘进入的短厚熊前臂以收拢的掌根外缘擂在盔顶侧面。腕根转折可辨，指端退到接触点后方，不环抱头盔；头盔向一侧被压低，敌人颈肩同向下沉。只在接触处留一小块压缩亮形，熊白肩仅露边角。

大形与负形：竖直短行程的重击压低一个明确的头盔受体，背景保留大块暗面。
色彩：暗酒红、铁灰头盔、灰白毛边、青色小爪尖。

25:19横向卡牌插画，只有画面，没有文字、标题、费用、边框或游戏UI。厚而克制的深色轮廓，硬边平涂，2—3个明暗层；少数完整大色块，背景服从唯一主读法。这是有意设计的图形概括，不用软质3D毛发、密集碎毛、体积光和粒子填充。实体角色出现时保持白灰宽肩、深蓝身体、短厚熊吻、青眼与青色短弯爪；只有场景确实露出胸部时才需要胸辫。纯环境或符号图不额外塞熊头、爪子或身份标记。用大形、留白、受力与尺度传达厚重和野性，不能把圆身摆拍、随机拉长的肢体或多余零件当作抽象。

参考用途：身份图用于确认实体角色；C06《进逼》用于主形清晰度、重量和气质；R31《天声震落》用于色块简洁或对象关系。借用这些方法，不复制它们的角色占位、动作轴或独特构图。

明确避免：指爪环抱头盔像抓头；手掌包住整个头颈；爪尖反折；省掉腕根像独立扣盖；巨大前臂横穿画面；持续按住而没有冲击结果。
图像语义：目标必须读成头盔与肩，明确是擂首而非推墙。
只表现上述单一场面，不增加说明文字、分镜、数值图标或与主动作无关的对象。
